## Core Frequently Asked Questions
### What core problem does this platform solve?
Stripe provides the unified economic infrastructure for the internet. It enables businesses of all scales—from startups to enterprise platforms—to accept multi-currency payments, orchestrate money movement, manage complex subscription billing models, issue cards, automate fraud prevention with machine learning (Radar), and sync financial data with corporate databases.
